messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-gpu-usw2: multiple pools hitting saturation — p95 queue > 2.8s. heatmap: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted/gpu-pool-heatmap

mia: saw it, heatmap looks noisy, dup alerts flooding the channel :alarm_fire:

rahul: any deploys during spike? last deploy 02:14 UTC. seems admission pressure—can someone pull admission-control and warm-image logs?

julia: quick prom check suggests warm-image failures coincident with a burst to embeddings-service

julia: ```
max by(pool) (increase(admission_queue_duration_seconds_count[5m]))
# spike on pool-3 and pool-4
```

sam: provisioner logs show timeouts: "provisioner: failed to attach image after 120s -> registry 429" => partner mirror rate-limited

leo: note: alertmanager change merged yesterday might be duplicating routes, amplifying noise

mia: short-term mitigation: bump admission quota for hosted-usw2 by +15% and enable fast-warm on two standby nodes
command: `redwoodctl admission adjust --region usw2 --delta +15%`

rahul: ok for a short window, but what's the cost impact?

julia: rough calc: +15% throughput ~ $4.5k/day if sustained; 3 hours ~= $560

sam: root cause looks like registry throttling -> image warm failures -> cold starts -> admission queueing. short fallback: switch warm-image source to cached-registry-2 for usw2

mia: actions: @sam switch registry to cached-registry-2; @rahul watch p95 and headroom; @julia revert alert duplication; @leo contact partner ops on rate limits

ops-bot: runbook created: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/hosted/usw2-saturation-1758765432 — checklist: increase-admission, enable-fast-warm, swap-registry, mute-duplicate-alerts

sam: swapped registry at 1758765470, image pulls starting to succeed, warm success 37% -> 92%

mia: queue p95 dropping, now ~0.9s, heatmap calming

julia: reverted duplicate routes in AM at 1758765488, suppressed duplicates for incident channel

rahul: will watch another 30m then rollback admission delta

mia: short summary: cause = registry throttle causing warm failures -> cold starts -> admission pressure; dup alerts made triage noisy. mitigations applied and effective. follow-ups: partner SLA, deploy cached-registry plan, tighten alert grouping

ops-bot: incident marked resolved (monitoring) at 1758765520 :white_check_mark:
